sources.title: ️ CRNN Handwriting Recognition with Trigram Language Model
sources.snippet: This project implements a high-performance Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network (CRNN) for recognizing handwritten text, specifically trained and evaluated on the world-renowned IAM Handwriting Database. It features a hybrid deep learning architecture combined with a Trigram-based Language Model for advanced post-processing.

sources.title: Intelligent-Handwriting-Recognition-Using-Deep-Neural-Networks
sources.snippet: Deep learning-based handwriting recognition using CRNN (CNN + BiLSTM) and ResNet-CTC models. Trained on the IAM Handwriting Dataset, this project automatically converts handwritten words into digital text, evaluates accuracy, visualizes predictions, and analyzes character-level confusion patterns effectively.

sources.title: IsmatS/handwriting_recognition · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This project implements a state-of-the-art Handwriting Recognition system that converts handwritten text images into digital text. The model achieves 87% character-level accuracy on the IAM Handwriting Database.
